what: CO-T Phase 1: seam stability up to Pe 200 (the coolant plan)

criteria.S1: positive control: with whole traces (m = n), max |u - u_monolithic| <= 1e-10 max |u_monolithic|, every layout, Pe and problem
criteria.S2: positive real: the smallest eigenvalue of the symmetric part of the free interface matrix is > 0 at m = 4, 8, 16 and 32, every layout, Pe and problem
criteria.S3: passive pieces: under the skew and upwind splits every piece's exact port matrix (m = 16) has lambda_min(sym) >= -1e-10 max |lambda|
criteria.S4: quasi-optimal: at m = 16 the coupled relative energy error <= 10 times the oracle's, wherever the oracle's exceeds 1e-10, every layout, Pe and problem
criteria.S5: no amplification: on the channel at Pe 200 (n = 128, m = 16) cut into 1, 2, 4 and 8 pieces, S4 holds at every length
criteria.S6: Petrov-Galerkin: the slope of log ||S~ - S|| against log eps over eps = 0.1, 0.03, 0.01, 0.003 is >= 1.8 with adjoint modes, every layout and Pe in the set
